feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: California gas prices have long plagued Democratic candidates. This year is different
entry.summary: Gas prices in California continue to be the highest in the nation, but the war in Iran has given California Democrats a rare opportunity to turn the tables on the issue.

entry.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
entry.summary: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. Six in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

entry.title: Putin releases American Stephen Hubbard from Russian prison
entry.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has freed another American, 74-year-old Michigan native Stephen Hubbard, from a Russian prison following a request from President Trump.

entry.title: Vivek Ramaswamy's attack ad features mother of Amy Acton, who alleges childhood abuse
entry.summary: A campaign ad by Republican candidate for Ohio governor Vivek Ramaswamy includes the mother of Democrat Amy Acton. Acton says they've been estranged since she was abused as a child by her stepfather.

entry.title: Candidates lock in for final sprint in Texas U.S. Senate race
entry.summary: What issues are bringing individuals to the polls in this key race that could decide the balance of power in Congress? What last minute push is being made by the campaigns?

entry.title: Arizona adds U.S.'s newest national park, but National Park Service remains underfunded
entry.summary: President Trump, famous for stripping protections from national monuments, is signing a bill to turn one into a national park. The land in southern Arizona is biologically rich and scenic.

entry.title: AI is shaking up the field of mathematics. But what comes next?
entry.summary: AI-written mathematical proofs have saddled the community with a lot of extra homework.

entry.title: How Aaron Dessner became pop music's authenticity whisperer
entry.summary: Dessner, best known as a member of the rock band The National, has become a sought-after producer for pop stars and singer-songwriters, including Taylor Swift, Gracie Abrams and Noah Kahan.

entry.title: Justice Kagan criticizes the Supreme Court on elections and voting
entry.summary: Supreme Court Justice Elena Kagan told an audience that the conservative majority is blinding itself to the consequences of its decisions on voting rights, gerrymandering and campaign finance.

entry.title: UN warns world is on track to double global warming unless countries change course
entry.summary: The United Nations warns that countries are not meeting their goals to limit warming and avoid the worst consequences of climate change.
